title: sorbus buekkensis
intro: Sorbus buekkensis, commonly known as Bükki mountain ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree species native to the Bükki Mountains in Hungary. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus buekkensis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
